alate: Head capsule blackish brown, the pronotum dull yellow, the postmentum concolorous with the head capsule but slightly paler, with a yellow spot in the middle; the labrum and postclypeus dull brown, the femoral segments blackish brown, the tibiae greyish yellow, the wings dull brown. The head capsule is long-oval, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.53 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are roundly triangular, the projection rate 4 per cent, the short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are circular, the diameter equal to the ocellus-compound eye distance. The dorsal margin of the head arches gently, the vertex rather flat, the postclypeus slightly raised, lower than the vertex and level with the ocelli. Antennae with 18–19 segments. The pronotum is step-like, 1.42–1.47 times as wide as long, the anterior margin nearly straight with a shallow median incision, the median notch of the posterior margin rather deep. The forewing 7.8–8.3 mm long and about 2.14 mm wide; the hindwing 7.19–7.65 mm long and about 1.99 mm wide; the Cu vein with about eight branches.
soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.52–0.53, the sides nearly parallel and somewhat narrowed behind the antennal sockets, the posterior margin slightly rounded. The frontal ridge is strongly raised, shallowly concave between the two ridges. The labrum is lingulate, the apex broad and rounded, the semi-transparent region with a bluntly angular appearance; the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs fine or indistinct. The mandibles are short and stout, their apices strongly curved like a hook, the mandibular condyle distinct, the mandibular length 0.9–0.93 times the head width. Antennae with 17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins first parallel and then expanding outwards; the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.31–0.34. The pronotum is approximately trapezoidal, about 1.52–1.58 times as wide as long, the anterior margin broadly V-shaped concave, the posterior margin nearly straight with the middle slightly concave, with more than thirty hairs in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.
